spec.claim_summary: A system compares price to its slowest moving average across ten timeframes where more aligned timeframes means higher success.
spec.untestable_reason: No mechanical rule can be recovered because MA length, alignment definition, entry trigger, exit, asset and direction are unstated and 10-timeframe alignment is not expressible.
assumptions: No asset stated; using BTCUSDT as default proxy.
No single timeframe stated; using 1d as default single timeframe.
No moving-average length, type, or alignment definition stated.
No entry trigger, exit, or direction stated; defaulting direction to long for schema completeness.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: alignment across 10 different time frames and scaling success/position by count of aligned timeframes; multi-timeframe conditions cannot be expressed.
